export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/accurate-ceramica): "Total Shipments 42 Records detected"; rows actually visible on the free page: 5. Exact line: "2024-08-12 | ACCURATE CERAMICA | CERAMIC GLAZED VITRIFIED TILES 800X1600MM ... | MUNDRA SEA, India -> NOVOROSSIYSK, RUSSIA | HS 69072100 | BOL 3150004". Other visible rows: 2024-07-06 (BOL 2240613), 2024-06-26 (BOL 1961632), 2024-06-07 (BOL 1513968) — all Mundra Sea -> Novorossiysk, Russia, HS 69072100, ceramic glazed vitrified tiles 600x600 mm, exporter GST quoted in the record as 24AAECR7320P1Z3; plus 2025-04-04 Ahmedabad ICD -> St Petersburg, Russia, HS 49111020, BOL 9675988 (catalogues, sample).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: 4 dated sea shipments of HS 69072100 vitrified tiles from Mundra to Novorossiysk (Jun–Aug 2024) with bill-of-lading numbers, so the declared HS 690721 matches the actual customs code — no HS correction needed. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 42 shipments / 2 trading partners / 4 port lanes; only 5 rows were visible without a paid subscription, so the remaining 37 records are unverified. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could not be retrieved: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown, not 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free pages — left null, not estimated. Note the 2025-04-04 record lists the counterparty as 'ACCURATE CERAMICA LIMTED LIABILITY COMPANY' (Russian entity, Moscow) buying catalogues — i.e. a related-name Russian buyer, not proof of Indian domestic supply.
